description: Manifest for the preenfm3 full-render golden-master fixtures. See tests/golden/README.md and _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/golden-master-test-plan.md. Each entry corresponds to one TEST in tests/golden_master_test.cpp. The full render is NOT byte-stable across compilers (libm differences in Osc::init/Env::init precomputed tables, amplified by FM feedback), so each supported compiler has its OWN committed fixture; tests/golden_master_test.cpp selects by __clang__/__GNUC__.

comparison.artifactType: int32_t DAC-format render (3 buffers x 64 stereo per block = 192 int32/block)
comparison.hashAlgorithm: FNV-1a 64-bit over tolerance-normalized buffer + splitmix64 finalizer (self-contained, no system xxhash)
comparison.buildFlag: -ffp-contract=off (tests/CMakeLists.txt) — strict IEEE mul/add, no FMA contraction, for best per-compiler reproducibility

determinism.scope: per-compiler (clang render != gcc render by >1 LSB within ~1 block due to libm-driven table differences amplified by FM feedback; each compiler is self-consistent)
determinism.rng: HAL_RNG gated to seed 0 under PFM3_HOST (Synth.cpp:285); downstream noise[] fill loop shared host/firmware
determinism.selfCheck: GoldenMaster.DeterminismSelfCheck renders twice in-process and asserts byte-exact equality (per-compiler)

compilers.localDev: macOS Apple clang (default CI dev leg is gcc; clang fixture generated locally)

compilers.ci: ubuntu-latest system g++ (the CI Host-unit-tests + Coverage legs)

fixtures.preset: default preenMainPreset (copied by Synth::init into timbre 0)
fixtures.noteSequence: noteOn(timbre=0, note=69 [A4], velocity=100) before block 0; no note-off
fixtures.warmStart: all 200 blocks captured incl. smoothVolume_/smoothPan_ one-pole transient (~blocks 0-10)
fixtures.guards: the entire Synth -> Timbre -> Voice -> Matrix -> FxBus -> int32 mix chain on clang

fixtures.preset: default preenMainPreset (copied by Synth::init into timbre 0)
fixtures.noteSequence: noteOn(timbre=0, note=69 [A4], velocity=100) before block 0; no note-off
fixtures.warmStart: all 200 blocks captured incl. smoothVolume_/smoothPan_ one-pole transient (~blocks 0-10)
fixtures.guards: the entire Synth -> Timbre -> Voice -> Matrix -> FxBus -> int32 mix chain on gcc
fixtures.bootstrapNote: generated under ubuntu/gcc in CI (clang vs gcc diverge by >1 LSB within ~1 block due to libm-driven table differences amplified by FM feedback); see tests/golden/README.md -> Cross-compiler fixtures.
